455:t_1:3.en: ～ $$マクロス・クォーター$$ Hangar ～

455:t_1:4.en:
$$カイエン$$
「...Got it. I'll talk to $$アマタ$$ myself.」

455:t_1:6.en:
$$カイエン$$
「That's unusual. You calling me that.」

455:t_1:7.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「Yeah... But right now, I just feel like it.」

455:t_1:8.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「I don't really know why, even myself...」

455:t_1:9.en:
$$カイエン$$
「But battle is no game. Now that you've said you'll do it, I won't allow you to do anything that drags everyone down.」

455:t_1:11.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「Even if I have to stake my life on it.」

455:t_1:12.en:
$$カイエン$$
「...Don't worry. I'll definitely protect you.」

455:t_1:14.en:
$$カイエン$$
「Don't get the wrong idea. It won't be me who protects you.」

455:t_1:16.en:
$$カイエン$$
「Do your best, $$ミコノ$$. You're not the girl who 'can never do it' anymore, after all.」

455:t_1:18.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$ミコノ$$... do you have a minute?」

455:t_1:20.en:
$$セツコ$$
「...It'll be all right. I'm sure you can do it.」

455:t_1:21.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「You understand what I'm trying to do, don't you, $$セツコ$$?」

455:t_1:23.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I hear that man called $$ミカゲ$$ is the hatred of $$頭翅#pilot$$, a $$堕天翅$$, given form.」

455:t_1:25.en:
$$セツコ$$
「If anyone can stop him, it has to be you... Do your best.」

455:t_1:26.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「...You fought $$頭翅#pilot$$ together with the $$神話型アクエリオン$$ once, didn't you, $$セツコ$$?」

455:t_1:28.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「What kind of girl was $$シルフィ$$...?」

455:t_1:30.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「I... want to know about her.」

455:t_2:6.en:
$$アマタ$$
「$$ゼシカ$$, $$アクエリオン$$, even $c... they're all gone...」

455:t_2:10.en:
$$カグラ$$
「Yo... it's been a while, $$アマタ$$.」

455:t_2:15.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「What is the meaning of this!?」

455:t_2:16.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You have no right to do this! Why do you keep interfering with the Wingless like this!?」

455:t_2:18.en:
$$不動$$
「...True, a being that has become a higher-dimensional life form is not permitted to interfere with humanity more than necessary...」

455:t_2:19.en:
$$不動$$
「But don't you think such a rule is itself presumptuous?」

455:t_2:21.en:
$$不動$$
「True, we may have gained eternity and the $$オリジン・ロー$$, but that is all there is to it.」

455:t_2:22.en:
$$不動$$
「We rejoice, rage, grieve, enjoy, hate, love... Nothing has changed.」

455:t_2:23.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You...! Where did you send that woman!?」

455:t_2:25.en:
$$不動$$
「The place where you were born.」

455:t_2:34.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「You are the ones from 12,000 years ago...!」

455:t_2:36.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「$$アポロ$$...! Is that you, $$アポロ$$!?」

455:t_2:39.en:
$$シリウス$$
(My precious little sister of the future...)

455:t_2:41.en:
$$頭翅#pilot$$
(The girl who was born between an $$天翅$$ and a Wingless, who tormented me, and then saved me...)

455:t_2:43.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「12,000 years ago... you sacrificed yourselves to save me and the world from the dimensional collapse...」

455:t_2:44.en:
$$シリウス$$
(There is no need to apologize.)

455:t_2:46.en:
$$シリウス$$
(You, and we as well, only did the best we could at that time...)

455:t_2:47.en:
$$アポロ$$
(Besides, just as we promised, we've met again like this...)

455:t_2:48.en:
$$頭翅#pilot$$
(Yes... because humans and $$天翅$$s were able to be connected...)

455:t_2:49.en:
$$頭翅#pilot$$
(That is the mingling of waters... Everything melts together and grows beautifully clear...)

455:t_2:50.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「$$アポロ$$... But I'm no longer $$シルヴィア$$...」

455:t_2:51.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You hateful woman, who took the one I love from me not once but twice!」

455:t_2:53.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「At the collapse of the universe 12,000 years ago, $$頭翅#pilot$$, an $$天翅$$, offered himself to the $$機械天使アクエリオン$$ together with the humans...」

455:t_2:54.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「He was supposed to become one with his beloved Wings of the Sun, but in the final moment, $$頭翅#pilot$$ learned that it had all been a lie.」

455:t_2:55.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Yes...! The $$機械天使アクエリオン$$ was not the Wings of the Sun, $$アポロニアス#pilot$$!」

455:t_2:57.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I am the shadow of the heart that $$頭翅#pilot$$, who lives for love, cut away...!」

455:t_2:60.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「Stop making yourself suffer any more.」
